WITH city_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT city, SUM(upload_bytes)::numeric AS upload, SUM(download_bytes)::numeric AS download FROM public.dashboard_ban_hourly_traffic_city WHERE bucket >= #{startAt} AND bucket < #{endAt} GROUP BY city
SELECT COALESCE( NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' ) AS city, SUM(GREATEST(to_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS upload, SUM(GREATEST(from_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS download FROM public.ban_history WHERE populate_time >= #{startAt} AND populate_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY city
), top_cities AS ( ( SELECT city, upload, download FROM city_totals ORDER BY upload DESC, city LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT city, upload, download FROM city_totals ORDER BY download DESC, city LIMIT #{limit} ) ), totals AS ( SELECT SUM(upload)::numeric AS upload, SUM(download)::numeric AS download FROM city_totals ) SELECT NULL::text AS city, upload::text AS upload_bytes, download::text AS download_bytes FROM totals UNION ALL SELECT city, upload::text AS upload_bytes, download::text AS download_bytes FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT city, upload, download FROM top_cities ) selected

WITH city_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT city, SUM(upload_bytes)::numeric AS upload, SUM(download_bytes)::numeric AS download FROM public.dashboard_swarm_hourly_traffic WHERE bucket >= #{startAt} AND bucket < #{endAt} GROUP BY city
SELECT COALESCE( NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' ) AS city, SUM(GREATEST(to_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS upload, SUM(GREATEST(from_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS download FROM public.swarm_tracker WHERE last_time_seen >= #{startAt} AND last_time_seen < #{endAt} GROUP BY city
), top_cities AS ( ( SELECT city, upload, download FROM city_totals ORDER BY upload DESC, city LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT city, upload, download FROM city_totals ORDER BY download DESC, city LIMIT #{limit} ) ), totals AS ( SELECT SUM(upload)::numeric AS upload, SUM(download)::numeric AS download FROM city_totals ) SELECT NULL::text AS city, upload::text AS upload_bytes, download::text AS download_bytes FROM totals UNION ALL SELECT city, upload::text AS upload_bytes, download::text AS download_bytes FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT city, upload, download FROM top_cities ) selected
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.dashboard_swarm_hourly_traffic ( bucket, city, upload_bytes, download_bytes, refreshed_at ) SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', last_time_seen) AS bucket, COALESCE( NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' ) AS city, SUM(GREATEST(to_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS upload_bytes, SUM(GREATEST(from_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS download_bytes, NOW() FROM public.swarm_tracker WHERE last_time_seen >= #{startAt} AND last_time_seen < #{endAt} GROUP BY bucket, city ON CONFLICT (bucket, city) DO UPDATE SET upload_bytes = EXCLUDED.upload_bytes, download_bytes = EXCLUDED.download_bytes, refreshed_at = EXCLUDED.refreshed_at
